name: Ketaki Datta

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Ketaki Datta is a poet, novelist, translator and literary reviewer with a background in teaching English in Kolkata. Her writing moves between original fiction and poetry, literary criticism and translation. Her collections include Across the Blue Horizon and The Music of Eternity; Urban Reflections brings her poems into conversation with Wilfried Raussert’s photographs.

In her Kabita Live poem ‘Pinpointing the emotions’, she asks whether anguish can be located as precisely as a chamber of the heart. The questions widen into the distinctions between loneliness and solitude, waiting and endurance. Autumn leaves, birds, still water and trembling dew carry the poem back towards remembered days of celebration.
